mapper.select: SELECT result.planArrivalNum as planArrivalNum, result.mat_code as matCode, result.mat_type as matType FROM (SELECT sum(plan_order_num - IFNULL(plan_arrival_num, 0)) AS planArrivalNum, mat_code, mat_type FROM pms_plan ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}) as result WHERE result.planArrivalNum > 0
